title: Learning the Projection onto the Data Support: Distribution Learning that Avoids Memorization
abstract: arXiv:2611.28234v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce a framework for learning distributions supported on manifolds based on estimating the nearest-point projection onto the data support. Specifically, we define an objective functional over a class of functions whose minimizer recovers this projection. The proposed framework automatically adapts to the intrinsic dimension and allows for data supported on unions of manifolds with varying dimensions. The resulting objective can be optimized using standard neural network architectures. We present population-level results establishing recovery of the manifold projection and prove finite-sample Wasserstein generalization bounds. Furthermore, we validate the approach empirically across a range of settings. In contrast to widely used generative models such as diffusion models, whose objectives can be minimized by memorizing training samples, our formulation excludes such behavior. translated_title: 学习数据支撑集上的投影：避免记忆化的分布学习
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种学习流形上支撑分布的框架，该框架基于估计到数据支撑集的最近点投影。具体而言，我们在一类函数上定义了一个目标泛函，其最小化点可以恢复该投影。所提出的框架能够自动适应数据的内在维度，并支持数据分布在具有不同维度的多个流形的并集上。所得到的目标函数可以使用标准神经网络架构进行优化。我们给出了总体层面的理论结果，证明了流形投影的恢复性，并证明了有限样本下的 Wasserstein 泛化界。此外，我们在一系列设置中对该方法进行了实证验证。与扩散模型等广泛使用的生成模型不同——这些模型的目标可以通过记忆训练样本来最小化——我们的公式化排除了这种记忆化行为。我们还引入了一种直接的记忆化度量来验证这一点。
tldr: 提出了一种通过学习数据支撑集上最近点投影来实现流形上分布学习的新框架，该框架能自动适应内在维度并支持多维度流形并集，且其优化目标从原理上排除了通过记忆训练样本实现的解，从而避免了扩散模型等生成模型中的记忆化问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a framework for learning distributions supported on manifolds by learning the nearest-point projection onto the data support, which automatically adapts to intrinsic dimension and provably excludes the memorization of training samples—a failure mode of diffusion models and other generative models.
